title: 1887 Yellow River flood
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1887 Yellow River flood", at revision 1379364844, opens: "The 1887 Yellow River flood in the Qing Dynasty was a flood in China that began in late September 1887 and killed at least 930,000 people. It was the single deadliest flood in Chinese history, as well as one of the largest natural disasters by death toll in recorded history." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1142904, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "flood on the Yellow River in China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
